product_metadata.title: Equity by La Crosse 30228 LED Alarm Clock,Black 4.50"W x 1.85"D x 2.65"H
description: Stay prepared for each morning using the ever-reliable Equity by La Crosse 30228 Electric LED Alarm Clock. It features a 0.60" red LED display that is easy to read. The Equity by La Crosse alarm clock is AC powered, but also features a backup option using a 9V battery for power when the electricity is out. A beep alarm helps the user wake up each morning to start a daily routine. The clock offers a repeatable snooze option so you can rest for an additional nine minutes. The clock display indicates for PM hours and shows when the alarm is active.
